_meta.what: Pre-edit spec_component output pinned for BAR-2 before/after (S4). Captured from the legacy source (exact-id lookup + the hardcoded _COMPONENT_ARCHETYPES 8-slug island + the generic ['container','content'] husk) BEFORE the SEED-FROM-NODE retrofit, over the v3 SEED stratum (the 5 SEED component types) plus an unknown type (the generic-husk probe). The legacy tool read a NON-EXISTENT a11y_role field + a hardcoded keyword_map and DROPPED each component's OWN accessibility_requirements even on a HIT.
_meta.a11y_field_drop_bug: legacy read kb_pattern.get('a11y_role') (0/66 components carry a11y_role) + a hardcoded keyword_map; the corpus field is 'accessibility_requirements'. On a HIT that is not one of the 8 archetype slugs (navbar/stepper/dropdown_menu), accessibility.role='' and wcag_requirements=[] — the component's own accessibility_requirements never surface. The legacy output has NO accessibility_requirements / retrieval_state / from_knowledge_base key at all.

husk_facts_the_retrofit_inverts.hit_drops_own_a11y: navbar/stepper/dropdown_menu HITs return accessibility.role='' + wcag_requirements=[]; their 6/5/7 own accessibility_requirements are dropped.
husk_facts_the_retrofit_inverts.archetype_slugs_shadow_real_components: 'input' and 'navigation' do NOT resolve to a corpus id; the legacy tool returns the hardcoded archetype husk (input->textbox archetype anatomy, navigation->navigation archetype anatomy) instead of the real text_input/navbar rich fields.
husk_facts_the_retrofit_inverts.generic_husk_on_unknown: an unknown type returns anatomy ['container','content'], variants ['default'], empty common_mistakes/a11y — a confident husk, never a fail-closed abstention.
husk_facts_the_retrofit_inverts.responsive_and_tokens_computed_not_own: responsive_behavior is a computed _RESPONSIVE_BREAKPOINTS dict and design_tokens is generated from the component name — NOT the component's own responsive_behavior / design_tokens_needed corpus fields.

modal_HIT.note: modal is BOTH a corpus id AND an archetype slug, so the legacy a11y came from the archetype (role='dialog') + WCAG enrichment — never modal's own 8 accessibility_requirements.

input_husk_archetype.note: 'input' is an archetype slug, NOT a corpus id (the real component is text_input). Legacy returns the hardcoded textbox archetype husk.

navigation_husk_archetype.note: 'navigation' is an archetype slug, NOT a corpus id (the real component is navbar). Legacy returns the hardcoded navigation archetype husk.
